exact_results.scalar_schur_rank: After multiplying by the Cauchy denominator, a scalar generalized-Schur kernel has feature rank <=2.
exact_results.scalar_de_branges_rank: A scalar de Branges numerator has feature rank <=2.
exact_results.complement_channels: The exact K0-Kt displacement uses E0,E0#,Et,Et# with J=diag(1,-1,-1,1).
exact_results.necessary_test: Scalarization implies every sampled displacement matrix has rank <=2, equivalently all 3x3 minors vanish.

firewall: Finite negative-square index controls inertia, not displacement rank.
A numerical rank-2 sample is not a proof of global scalar collapse.
A certified nonzero 3x3 displacement minor is a valid scalarization rejection.
